descriptionFull: The chimney swift ( Chaetura pelagica ) is a bird belonging to the swift family Apodidae. A member of the genus Chaetura , it is closely related to both the Vaux's swift and the Chapman's swift; in the past, the three were sometimes considered to be conspecific. It has no subspecies.
